summary: Frontend-only testing of the 'Oblíbené nemovitosti' (Favorites) feature end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL. All acceptance criteria from the review request pass: favoriting from a card fires the sonner toast 'Přidáno do oblíbených', turns the heart filled red, updates the navbar badge count, and writes the id to localStorage under key 'remax_favorites'. Adding a 2nd favorite increments the badge to 2 and stores 2 ids. Navigating via nav-favorites to /oblibene shows the exact favorited cards with a correct count text ('2 oblíbených nemovitosti'). Reloading /oblibene persists both favorites (localStorage persistence confirmed). Removing a favorite triggers 'Odebráno z oblíbených' toast, the card disappears, count and badge decrease; removing all reveals the empty state and 'Prohlédnout nabídku' button. Property detail page heart at top-right of gallery toggles favorites and reflects on navbar badge + localStorage. Note: unrelated 401 console warnings are logged (image asset auth) but do not affect the feature.
critical_code_review_comments: FavoritesContext writes to localStorage on every render including the initial mount (useEffect runs after initial state loaded from LS). This is harmless but re-serializes on hydration; consider skipping first write.
Unrelated: several 401 responses observed in console during /oblibene page load (likely image proxies). Not part of this feature but worth investigating.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie banner uses data-testid='cookie-accept' for the accept button; the wrapper carries data-testid='cookie-consent'. Clicking the wrapper does NOT dismiss it — use 'cookie-accept'. Use ?nolenis=1 to disable Lenis smooth scroll. Favorites are purely client-side via localStorage key 'remax_favorites'.
